Name: Cozy Spouse Rooms And Patios
Author: sheepfield
Description:
This mod makes the spouse rooms a bit cozier. It also allows placing windows and wall sconces from the furniture catalogus or from Robin's shop. The windows will turn dark at night (and during rainy days), and the wall sconces will light up at night.

Some of the new patios have a few more or different plants.

Use Generic Mod Config Menu to switch between different versions with slight changes. You may have to exit and then re-enter the farmhouse or the farm map to load the changes.

It works with Generic Mod Config Menu, but it's not required. You can also change the config.json directly. Start the game once to let it generate the config file, and then you can edit it,



[b]Notes
[/b]
- You can only add windows and wall sconces at some places at the walls. SpouseRooms2 has emptier spouse rooms, so more space to decorate according to your wishes. Except for Harvey, he has only one space for a window.

- Walls may accept wall paper, but it won't show up. You'll still lose the wallpaper. So be careful.

- You can walk through Elliot's chair. This way it looks like he's sitting while working at his book. 

- After changing the settings in Generic Mod Config Menu, You may have to exit and then re-enter the farmhouse or the farm map to load the changes. If that doesn't work, save the game by sleeping at night. If that also doesn't work, exit game to title and then reload your save. Last resort is exiting the game completely and restarting it.



[b]Installation[/b]

Requirements are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
Extract the mod to the Mods folder in the Stardew Valley folder.

Recommended but not required: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]
Recommended if you'll marry Sebastion: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7837]Lively Frog Sanctuary[/url]



[b]Permissions[/b]

Make changes, patches, new versions, if you want, just no changes with AI. Please add a link back to this mod page.
